observations: The target EXE loader calls the word at DOSDATA:0d08 where the historical source calls fixexepatch; it tests byte DOSDATA:0d07 where the source tests DosHasHMA.
Target initialization sets the byte at 0d07 and updates the word at 0d08 when DOS enters the HMA.

Target initialization sets words at 0d08 and 0d0a to the same default routine, followed by ChkCopyProt at 0061, matching the historical initialization order of fixexepatch, RationalPatchPtr and ChkCopyProt.
The second EXE loader call uses DOSDATA:133e, corresponding to Rational386PatchPtr, not RationalPatchPtr.
limitations: Symbol names are inferred by comparing multiple target instruction sequences with historical source; original 7.0a symbol names are not independently recovered.
The exact source ownership and preceding target layout of these variables remain unverified.
No complete executable link or target-wide equivalence has been established.
